events.title: Æthelred II orders the St Brice's Day massacre of Danes
events.description: King Æthelred the Unready ordered the killing of Danish men in England. Victims reputedly included the sister of Sweyn Forkbeard, who launched repeated invasions and took the English crown in 1013.
events.html: King Æthelred the Unready ordered the killing of Danish men in England. Victims reputedly included the sister of Sweyn Forkbeard, who launched repeated invasions and took the English crown in 1013.

events.title: Malcolm III of Scotland is killed at Alnwick
events.description: Malcolm III was killed in an ambush while besieging Alnwick Castle in Northumberland, together with his eldest son. A succession struggle followed in Scotland.
events.html: Malcolm III was killed in an ambush while besieging Alnwick Castle in Northumberland, together with his eldest son. A succession struggle followed in Scotland.

events.title: Louis VII of France marries Adela of Champagne
events.description: King Louis VII of France married Adela of Champagne, his third wife, who became queen of France. Her son Philip II went on the Third Crusade, during which Adela was regent of France from 1190 to 1191.
events.html: King Louis VII of France married Adela of Champagne, his third wife, who became queen of France. Her son Philip II went on the Third Crusade, during which Adela was regent of France from 1190 to 1191.

events.title: Parliament's army blocks the Royalists at Turnham Green
events.description: At Turnham Green, the much larger Parliamentarian army of the Earl of Essex faced the forces of King Charles I in a standoff. By blocking the Royalist army's way to London, Parliament forced Charles to retreat to Oxford.
events.html: At Turnham Green, the much larger Parliamentarian army of the Earl of Essex faced the forces of King Charles I in a standoff. By blocking the Royalist army's way to London, Parliament forced Charles to retreat to Oxford.

events.title: Government forces halt the Jacobite advance at Sheriffmuir
events.description: A smaller government army under the Duke of Argyll fought the Jacobite army of the Earl of Mar near Dunblane in Scotland. Neither side won clearly, but Mar withdrew and the Jacobite rising of 1715 lost its momentum.
events.html: A smaller government army under the Duke of Argyll fought the Jacobite army of the Earl of Mar near Dunblane in Scotland. Neither side won clearly, but Mar withdrew and the Jacobite rising of 1715 lost its momentum.

events.title: American forces occupy Montreal
events.description: Continental troops under Richard Montgomery entered Montreal unopposed during the invasion of Canada. The campaign collapsed after the failed assault on Quebec City at the end of the year.
events.html: Continental troops under Richard Montgomery entered Montreal unopposed during the invasion of Canada. The campaign collapsed after the failed assault on Quebec City at the end of the year.

events.title: Emperor Charles withdraws from Hungarian affairs
events.description: At Eckartsau, Charles I renounced any part in Hungary's government, two days after a similar declaration for Austria. Habsburg rule over Austria-Hungary was effectively at an end.
events.html: At Eckartsau, Charles I renounced any part in Hungary's government, two days after a similar declaration for Austria. Habsburg rule over Austria-Hungary was effectively at an end.

events.title: Coordinated terrorist attacks kill 130 in Paris
events.description: Islamic State gunmen and suicide bombers attacked the Bataclan concert hall, cafés and the Stade de France. It was the deadliest attack in France since the Second World War, and a state of emergency followed.
